The central subscription enforcement middleware is fully functional with plan-based feature limits, expired subscription blocking (read-only mode), feature gating (export/automation), dynamic resource limits (panels/rules), and admin bypass.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 119 tested the Subscription Guard Middleware. Key findings: (1) GET /api/subscription/status returns plan, features, isExpired, endDate correctly. (2) Admin users (isAdmin=true) bypass all subscription checks and get enterprise plan. (3) Plan config SSOT in config/plan_features.py: free=3 panels/5 rules/no export/no automation, trial=5/20/export/automation, starter=10/50/export/automation, standard=25/100/export/automation, pro=50/200/export/automation, enterprise=unlimited. (4) Expired subscriptions block write operations with SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED error but allow read operations (read-only mode). (5) Feature gating works: free plan blocks export_excel and run_automation features with FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE error. (6) Resource limits work: free plan blocks panel creation at limit=3 with LIMIT_REACHED error. (7) Error responses have correct structure with error code, message, currentPlan, upgradeUrl. (8) All middleware functions (get_user_subscription, enforce_subscription, check_resource_limit) work correctly.
